1. Dual-Engine Framework

The framework combines a consistency rule with a spatial boundary metaphor. The first asks whether the same action is evaluated by the same rule across actors. The second represents how close an action is to a modeled response boundary while preserving the actor's intended utility.
Formula 1  Consistency or Shibboleth Check. For each declared relevant context c: ∀i, j ∈ P, ∀α ∈ A, W(i, α; c) = W(j, α; c).
Formula 2  Boundary Margin Model. Maximize U(α; c) over α ∈ F(i,c) with m(i,c)(α) = ε, where ε > 0.

Definitions: P is the actor set, A the available action set, and c a declared relevant context. In this binary audit W(i, α; c) ∈ {0, 1}, with 1 = restriction and 0 = permission. Equality tests outcomes, not identical reasoning or fairness. One counterexample to the universal claim is enough: some i, j, α in the same context have unequal W values. Context must not be chosen merely to hide the disparity under examination.

For the boundary model, place actions in a specified metric feature space X. ΩSin(i, c) is its permitted region, with nonempty boundary; F(i,c) = A ∩ ΩSin(i, c). Define m(i,c)(α) as distance to that boundary inside ΩSin, and minus that distance outside; boundary points have margin zero. Ordinary unsigned distance is never negative. The condition m = ε chooses an exact permitted-side edge margin. The alternative m ≥ ε requires minimum clearance and is not the same objective. Either feasible set can be empty; a maximizing action need not exist without further domain and regularity assumptions. These quantities operationalize the metaphor only after a representation and metric are chosen.

A stores accumulated input; κ converts that stored quantity to a source rate with the required units. This retains the original memory choice explicitly. Under closed or periodic boundaries, constant positive excess utility can make the total field grow quadratically in time because the stored input is integrated again by the evolution equation. Velocity and energy transfer are related but different mathematical quantities. Choosing either as S requires a corresponding law and units; using the same letter does not establish equivalence. `check_coupled_analytic.py` additionally evolves an independent exact-solution control through the same full solver: a decaying transverse shear, a passive context mode, its viscous heating and thermal diffusion, and the corresponding smoothed material trajectory and deformation gradient. Rigid-rotation tests independently check the material energy, stress, conductivity and recording drivers.

`check_coupled_transfer_budget.py` repeats the main trajectory with extra diagnostic counters only. It integrates net advective/conductive heat transport into the fixed region |x| > 0.32 separately from heat generated there by viscosity and expression release. That region is an observation control volume, not an asserted sharp material boundary. The final grid is compared with the uninstrumented main run; a locally generated temperature increase is not counted as transported heat.

No finite-horizon computation proves a limit cycle, all-history uniqueness, all-parameter robustness, global PDE regularity or physical clay behavior. Those are different claims from completing and checking this coupled candidate.
## 9. Scientific-method references for the added numerics

[Chen and Peskin's Fourier spectral immersed-boundary method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.08694) motivates divergence-free interpolation and adjoint interaction work. This implementation uses direct tensor-product interpolation matrices, not their NUFFT implementation or their validated solver. Their convergence results are not imported as evidence for this code.

[Peskin's immersed-boundary formulation](https://www.cambridge.org/core/services/aop-cambridge-core/content/view/95ECDAC5D1824285563270D6DD70DA9A/S0962492902000077a.pdf/div-class-title-the-immersed-boundary-method-div.pdf), [Bower's constitutive requirements](https://solidmechanics.org/Text/Chapter3_1/Chapter3_1.php) and [Berezovski on internal variables](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10217598/) provide general numerical and thermodynamic context.
